brief:
Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu said Israel faces an "unprecedented" opportunity to remove the threat posed by Iran, Middle East Eye reported. Netanyahu did not elaborate on what specific circumstances he believes create this opening or what action Israel might take.

The statement comes amid heightened regional tensions and ongoing concerns about Iranian nuclear capabilities and proxy activities across the Middle East.
dek: Netanyahu claims Israel has 'unprecedented' chance to remove Iranian threat Benjamin Netanyahu said that Israel has an "unprecedented" chance to eliminate the threat from Iran.
title: Netanyahu claims Israel has unprecedented chance to eliminate Iran threat
